intro.TrustedMarkup: A refusal's sentence, for the modules syntaxReport (std/syntax) writes. A program that only parses never loads it. A refusal's row as text: its name and each hole's name and value. A module syntaxReport writes builds one for syntaxSentence.

sig.TrustedMarkup: gen fn syntaxSentence(row: SyntaxRow, catalogue: String) -> String

prose.TrustedMarkup: What a refusal with row says, on one line. catalogue holds one Row=sentence line per entry of the grammar's <stem>.errors/en.json, as the parser's writer read it. In a sentence {$name} is a hole and a backslash escapes the next character. A row with no line reads as the row and its holes.
